subject: Trace storage tiering & long-term dashboard access — pricing question
messages:
From: Maya Reddy <maya@brightly.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightly.io
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on long-term trace storage & dashboards pricing

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the demo last week. We liked the low tail latency and the dashboard filters. Before we move to a formal SOW, procurement asked for clarity on two items: 1) pricing model for trace retention beyond 90 days (do you charge per GB-month or per-sampled-trace?), and 2) separate licensing for the advanced dashboards (seat-based vs. cluster-level).

A couple of notes from our side attached: a sample of our trace ingest (Brightly_Sample_Query_Retention.csv) and current retention profile.

Do you have a short matrix you can share that maps retention tiers to expected monthly cost at our projected volume (~6 TB ingested / month, 300M spans/month)? We have a renewal window in mid-November and want to decide whether to commit to a 12-month retention add-on.

Thanks — happy to hop on 30 minutes if easier.

—Maya
Maya Reddy
Head of Observability, Brightly
maya@brightly.io
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reddy <maya@brightly.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on long-term trace storage & dashboards pricing

Maya —

Appreciate the detail and the sample file. I pulled a couple of quick scenarios for you and attached an updated SKU sheet (SKU_Pricing_Sheet_v4.xlsx) that shows:

- Retention charging: base is per-GB-month for raw trace blobs, plus a marginal per-sampled-trace processing fee for cold retrievals after 90 days.
- Tier examples: 90 days (default), 180 days (+15% on storage), 365 days (+28%), and multi-year archive (custom pricing).
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards are offered as a cluster-level add-on (unlimited seats) or a seat-based premium if you want role-limited editing. Cluster-level is simpler for enterprise reporting.

For Brightly’s volumes, rough math (very back-of-envelope):
- 6 TB/month ingest -> ~180 TB retained at 30 days rolling. 365-day tier estimate: ~2.1 PB stored.
- Using our public SKU numbers, that maps to roughly $52k/mo for 365-day storage + ~$6k/mo for advanced dashboards (cluster add-on). I included a 10% committed usage discount example at 12-month commit in the sheet.

If you want, Rishi can put together a formal quote and propose a 12-month commit path that includes a 5% additional discount if you prepay quarterly. Stephanie, flag anything I should not promise on the legal/license side.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Maya Reddy <maya@brightly.io>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on long-term trace storage & dashboards pricing

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the data — I dug into the numbers and adjusted for your compression and sampled retrieval ratio. Couple of practical notes:

1) We can move Brightly into our "retention-slab" pricing rather than pure GB-month if you prefer predictability. That converts storage into slabs (e.g., up to 250TB, 250–1PB, 1PB+) with stepped unit pricing and includes one free cold retrieval per 10k traces per month.
2) For the dashboard add-on we can offer cluster-level access at $6k/mo as Lauren said, or seat-based at $150/user/mo if you only need 10–20 power users. Cluster add-on removes seat management overhead.
3) Regarding discounts: with a 12-month committed spend we can do 10% off list on the combined storage + dashboard line items; with a 24-month commit we can extend to 15%. The additional 5% for quarterly prepay Lauren proposed is doable but needs legal sign-off for invoice terms.

Maya, if you share an anticipated commit level (monthly spend target), I can run a break-even table against your current provider.

—Rishi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Reddy <maya@brightly.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightly.io
Date: 2026-10-04T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on long-term trace storage & dashboards pricing

Thanks Rishi — that slab model sounds promising. A few follow-ups from procurement attached: can you confirm SLA for cold retrieval latency beyond 90 days (we have some audit runs that pull older traces) and will retrieval costs be capped for bursty months? Procurement also asked whether advanced dashboards include historical retention queries or if that counts as retrieval compute.

We are considering a 12-month commit at ~65k/mo ARR for observability (storage + dashboards). Would that hit the 10% bracket?

—Maya
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reddy <maya@brightly.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on long-term trace storage & dashboards pricing

Maya —

Quick clarifications from legal/finance side:
- Cold retrieval SLA: we commit to <24 hours for batch retrievals as a default in the retention-slab contract, with a premium expedited retrieval SLA (12 hours) available for an additional fee. We will not guarantee per-trace low-latency retrieval for traces older than 90 days unless covered by an expedited clause.
- Burst caps: we can offer a protective cap mechanism (monthly retrieval budget) where retrievals above the cap are billed at a discounted overage rate rather than list. That would be defined in the SOW.
- Dashboard historical queries: cluster-level advanced dashboards include the UI and pre-aggregations; any ad-hoc raw trace rehydration counts as retrieval compute and falls under retrieval caps/overage.

If Brightly confirms a 12-month commit at $65k/mo ARR, finance can model the 10% committed discount and produce a draft SOW. We'll need a billing contact for prepay terms.

—Stephanie
Director, Contracts & Pricing, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Reddy <maya@brightly.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightly.io
Date: 2026-10-05T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on long-term trace storage & dashboards pricing

Stephanie, Lauren —

Thanks, that all sounds reasonable and aligns with what the team expected. Procurement ok'd a 12-month commitment at $65k/mo with the 10% committed discount applied and a monthly retrieval cap with discounted overage rates. Please go ahead and send a draft SOW with expedited retrieval as an optional line item.

Billing contact: procurement@brightly.io (Tomas Bhatia).

We attached a short note with required compliance docs; I'll upload those to the drive link you referenced.

Looking forward to next steps.

—Maya
